# ⚡ UItem - Powerful Custom Items Plugin for Minecraft

UItem is a modern custom item plugin designed for Paper, Purpur, and Folia servers.

Create powerful custom items with a visual editor, crafting recipes, resource pack generation, native skills & passives, and seamless integration with popular plugins such as Oraxen, ItemsAdder, and ExecutableItems.

## ✨ Features

### 🗡 Advanced Custom Items

Create unlimited custom items with:

* Custom display names (MiniMessage support)
* Custom lore
* Enchantments
* Item flags
* Custom Model Data
* Unbreakable items
* Glowing effects
* Custom durability
* Attribute modifiers
* Item rarity system
* Oraxen integration
* ItemsAdder integration
* AuraSkills integration

---

### 🎨 Automatic Resource Pack System

No need to manually create resource packs.

UItem can automatically:

* Generate model JSON files
* Register CustomModelData
* Export ZIP resource packs
* Generate SHA-1 hashes
* Host resource packs through the built-in HTTP server
* Automatically send resource packs to players

---

### ⚒ Advanced Crafting System

Create custom recipes using:

* Vanilla items
* UItem custom items

Supports:

* Shaped recipes
* Shapeless recipes
* Bulk crafting (1 / 8 / 64 / MAX)
* Automatic ingredient consumption

---

### ⚡ Native Skills & Passives

Unlike many plugins that require additional dependencies, UItem includes a built-in skill system.

Features:

* GUI-based skill editor
* YAML configuration support
* Persistent cooldown storage
* Folia-compatible scheduler
* Active and passive abilities
* Lightweight and highly optimized

Supported Triggers:

* RIGHT_CLICK
* SHIFT_RIGHT_CLICK
* HIT
* TAKE_DAMAGE
* EQUIP
* WHILE_HOLDING
* PERIODIC

Supported Actions:

* MESSAGE
* ACTION_BAR
* PLAY_SOUND
* GIVE_POTION
* HEAL
* DAMAGE
* LAUNCH
* SHOOT_PROJECTILE
* CONSOLE_COMMAND
* PLAYER_COMMAND
* STRIKE_LIGHTNING
* CONSUME_DURABILITY

---

### 🖥 Visual GUI Editor

Manage everything without touching configuration files.

Editor Features:

* Create items
* Edit materials
* Edit names and lore
* Configure enchantments
* Configure attributes
* Configure rarity
* Configure integrations
* Configure recipes
* Configure skills and passives

---

### 🔗 Plugin Integrations

Optional support for:

✔ Oraxen

✔ ItemsAdder

✔ AuraSkills

The plugin automatically detects and hooks into supported plugins.

---

### ⚙ Compatibility

Supported Servers:

* Paper 1.21.4+
* Purpur
* Spigot
* Folia (is testing no release)

Java Version:

* Java 21+

---

### 📦 Commands

* /uitem
* /ui
* /uitem give
* /uitem editor
* /uitem reload
* /uitem craft
* /crafting

---

### 🔐 Permissions

* uitem.admin
* uitem.give
* uitem.editor
* uitem.reload
* uitem.search
* uitem.craft

without requiring separate builds.

## ❤️ Made for Server Owners

Whether you're creating an RPG server, survival server, MMORPG experience, or a custom adventure world, UItem provides all the tools needed to build unique gameplay with custom items.
